verdict.rationale: The docs point developers to the separate open-source Python library for local agents (browser-use-docs-19, browser-use-probe-1, browser-use-gh-3). A hands-on community report confirms running it locally against a real browser and user profile (browser-use-comm-5), and another references the published setup for using your own Chrome profile (browser-use-comm-3). Missing for 10: an explicit statement that no cloud account or API key is required, and in-depth local quickstart documentation in the pack.
